title: Nicht die Gummireifen: Warum dich dein Auto vor dem Blitz schützt

hookAnchor.firstImage: lightning bolt striking the roof of a moving car at night

scenes.title: Warum passiert dir im Auto beim Blitz nichts?

visualRecipe.subject: A bright lightning bolt striking the roof of a moving car at night on a rainy country road, the glowing channel touching the metal roof, the calm driver clearly visible through the windshield.
visualRecipe.focus: a lightning strike hits a car while the driver inside stays unharmed.

scenes.voiceText: Ein Blitz trifft dein Auto. Über 30.000 Grad heiß. Warum passiert dir drinnen nichts?
scenes.factClaim: a lightning strike hits a car while the driver inside stays unharmed.

scenes.title: Heißer als kochendes Wasser

visualRecipe.stage: home kitchen stove next to a storm sky
visualRecipe.subject: Split comparison in one frame: on the left a small pot of boiling water on a kitchen stove with a short temperature bar, on the right a lightning channel with a temperature bar that towers far above it, both bars on the same scale.
visualRecipe.focus: the lightning channel is vastly hotter than boiling water.

scenes.voiceText: Die Luft im Blitzkanal wird dabei 300-mal heißer als kochendes Wasser.
scenes.factClaim: the lightning channel is vastly hotter than boiling water.

scenes.title: Enormer Strom in Sekundenbruchteilen

visualRecipe.stage: storm sky just above the ground
visualRecipe.subject: Close macro view of a glowing white-violet lightning channel just above the ground, one bold arrow along the channel showing the direction of the current.
visualRecipe.focus: an enormous current rushes through the thin lightning channel in an instant.

scenes.voiceText: Durch diesen dünnen Kanal jagen rund 20.000 Ampere. In wenigen Millionstel Sekunden.
scenes.factClaim: an enormous current rushes through the thin lightning channel in an instant.

scenes.title: Die Sicherung im Haus

visualRecipe.subject: Close view into an opened home fuse box: one white modular circuit breaker in focus with its toggle switched down, neighboring breakers softly blurred.
visualRecipe.focus: a normal household circuit breaker is rated for only 16 amperes.

scenes.voiceText: Deine Haushaltssicherung schaltet schon bei 16 Ampere ab.
scenes.factClaim: a normal household circuit breaker is rated for only 16 amperes.

scenes.title: Über tausendmal mehr Strom

visualRecipe.subject: Two vertical bars drawn to exact scale on a workshop wall chart: a tiny bar with a small circuit breaker icon at its base and an enormous bar with a lightning symbol that reaches far beyond it.
visualRecipe.focus: lightning current dwarfs the current of a household breaker.

scenes.voiceText: Der Blitzstrom ist über tausendmal stärker.
scenes.factClaim: lightning current dwarfs the current of a household breaker.

scenes.title: Eine Armlänge vom Blech

visualRecipe.stage: inside a car cabin during a thunderstorm
visualRecipe.subject: View from the passenger seat: a young driver with a natural face reaches out and almost touches the inner door panel, rain streaming down the side window, a faint lightning flash outside.
visualRecipe.focus: the driver sits only an arm's length away from the metal body.

scenes.voiceText: Und du sitzt nur eine Armlänge vom Blech entfernt, mitten im Gewitter.
scenes.factClaim: the driver sits only an arm's length away from the metal body.

scenes.title: Der Irrtum mit den Reifen

visualRecipe.stage: wet asphalt road beside the front wheel
visualRecipe.subject: Low close view of a car tire standing on wet asphalt, raindrops on the black rubber sidewall, one small question-mark-shaped highlight on the tire.
visualRecipe.focus: the rubber tire is widely believed to be the protection.

scenes.voiceText: Fast jeder glaubt, die Gummireifen retten dich. Das ist falsch. Gleich siehst du die Spuren, die es beweisen.
scenes.factClaim: the rubber tire is widely believed to be the protection.

scenes.title: Der lange Weg des Blitzes

visualRecipe.subject: Wide view of a towering anvil-shaped thunderstorm cloud above open farmland, a lightning bolt running from the cloud base down to a small car on a country road.
visualRecipe.focus: the lightning travels a very long way down from a towering storm cloud.

scenes.voiceText: Schau dir an, welchen Weg der Blitz schon hinter sich hat. Die Gewitterwolke ragt oft über zehn Kilometer hoch.
scenes.factClaim: the lightning travels a very long way down from a towering storm cloud.

scenes.title: Kilometer lange Entladung

visualRecipe.subject: Side-view atmospheric cross-section: storm cloud on top, a jagged lightning channel to the ground, and a vertical dimension line beside it running from cloud to ground.
visualRecipe.focus: the lightning channel is several kilometres long.

scenes.voiceText: Sein Kanal ist 4 bis 10 Kilometer lang.
scenes.factClaim: the lightning channel is several kilometres long.

scenes.title: Luft als Isolator

visualRecipe.subject: Laboratory spark gap on a lab bench: two polished metal spheres facing each other with a clear air gap between them and no spark yet.
visualRecipe.focus: air normally insulates, yet lightning crosses kilometres of it.

scenes.voiceText: Und diesen Weg legt er quer durch Luft zurück. Dabei ist Luft eigentlich ein guter Isolator.
scenes.factClaim: air normally insulates, yet lightning crosses kilometres of it.

scenes.title: Warum der Irrtum logisch klingt

visualRecipe.stage: electrician workbench with a cut cable
visualRecipe.subject: Macro view of a cut electrical cable on a workbench: shiny copper strands inside a thick plastic insulation sleeve.
visualRecipe.focus: the misconception comes from everyday cable insulation.

scenes.voiceText: Der Gedanke mit dem Gummi klingt trotzdem logisch. Schließlich isoliert auch die Hülle um jedes Kabel.
scenes.factClaim: the misconception comes from everyday cable insulation.

scenes.title: Zentimeter gegen Kilometer

visualRecipe.subject: One frame comparison: a huge lightning channel descending from far above, ending at a car wheel where only a thin rubber tire separates the rim from the road.
visualRecipe.focus: a few centimetres of rubber are nothing compared with kilometres of air.

scenes.voiceText: Was sollen da ein paar Zentimeter Gummi noch ausrichten? Für den Blitz sind sie nur ein winziger letzter Sprung.
scenes.factClaim: a few centimetres of rubber are nothing compared with kilometres of air.

scenes.title: Künstliche Blitze im Labor

visualRecipe.subject: Two engineers with natural faces stand behind a safety barrier in a large high-voltage test hall, watching a bright artificial discharge from a tall impulse generator strike the roof of a parked test car.
visualRecipe.focus: engineers test real cars with artificial lightning.

scenes.voiceText: In Hochspannungslaboren wurden echte Autos mit künstlichen Blitzen getroffen. Danach sah man genau hin.
scenes.factClaim: engineers test real cars with artificial lightning.

scenes.title: Brandspur am Reifen

visualRecipe.stage: test hall floor beside the test car
visualRecipe.subject: Close-up of a car tire sidewall with a thin dark scorched track running straight across the rubber from the rim down to the floor.
visualRecipe.focus: the scorch mark across the tire sidewall proves the current crossed the tire.

scenes.voiceText: Das Ergebnis: Brandspuren, die quer über die Reifenflanken laufen.
scenes.factClaim: the scorch mark across the tire sidewall proves the current crossed the tire.

scenes.title: Der Strom springt über

visualRecipe.stage: metal floor plate of the test hall
visualRecipe.subject: Side view of a test car wheel on a metal floor plate in a test hall: a bright short electric arc bridges from the steel wheel arch along the outside of the tire to the floor plate, one arrow showing the path.
visualRecipe.focus: the current simply jumps over the rubber tire.

scenes.voiceText: Der Strom ist einfach über den Reifen gesprungen. Der Gummi war ihm egal.
scenes.factClaim: the current simply jumps over the rubber tire.

scenes.title: Was schützt dich dann?

visualRecipe.subject: Top-down view of a car in a rain-wet parking lot: the four tires shown greyed out, the metal body shell softly highlighted in muted blue.
visualRecipe.focus: the tires are not the protection; something else must be.

scenes.voiceText: Die Reifen sind also nicht dein Schutz. Aber was schützt dich dann wirklich?
scenes.factClaim: the tires are not the protection; something else must be.

scenes.title: London im Jahr 1836

visualRecipe.subject: Historic London street scene in 1836: the columned facade of the Royal Institution building, horse carriages and pedestrians with natural faces in period clothing.
visualRecipe.focus: the story begins in London in 1836.

scenes.voiceText: Die Antwort beginnt 1836 in London, lange bevor es das erste Auto gab.
scenes.factClaim: the story begins in London in 1836.
scenes.chapterTitle: 1836: Ein Mann zieht in einen Metallwürfel

scenes.title: Faraday baut einen Würfel

visualRecipe.subject: Inside a curved wooden lecture theatre of the 1830s, Michael Faraday with a natural face points at a large wooden cube frame while two workers fit the beams together.
visualRecipe.focus: Michael Faraday has a huge cube built inside a lecture theatre.

scenes.voiceText: Im Hörsaal der Royal Institution lässt der Forscher Michael Faraday einen riesigen Würfel bauen. Wozu, ahnt noch niemand.
scenes.factClaim: Michael Faraday has a huge cube built inside a lecture theatre.

scenes.title: Kantenlänge des Würfels

visualRecipe.subject: Clean technical side view of the cube frame with a dimension line along one edge and a standing man beside it for scale, the cube more than twice his height.
visualRecipe.focus: the cube is taller than two people.

scenes.voiceText: Jede Kante ist 3,7 Meter lang.
scenes.factClaim: the cube is taller than two people.

scenes.title: Aufbau der Würfelwand

visualRecipe.subject: Cutaway of one corner of the cube wall showing the layers: wooden frame, a net of copper wires, paper covering and bands of tin foil connecting everything.
visualRecipe.focus: the cube walls are a fully conductive metal net.

scenes.voiceText: Holzrahmen, Kupferdraht, Papier und Zinnfolie. Alles ist überall leitend miteinander verbunden.
scenes.factClaim: the cube walls are a fully conductive metal net.

scenes.title: Die Elektrisiermaschine

visualRecipe.stage: beside the cube in the lecture hall
visualRecipe.subject: A large 1830s glass-plate electrostatic machine beside the foil-covered cube, a brass conductor leading to the outer wall, one arrow showing charge flowing onto the outside.
visualRecipe.focus: a large electrostatic machine charges the outside of the cube.

scenes.voiceText: Eine große Elektrisiermaschine lädt dann die Außenwand des Würfels kräftig auf.
scenes.factClaim: a large electrostatic machine charges the outside of the cube.

scenes.title: Funken an der Außenwand

visualRecipe.subject: The foil-covered cube standing in a dim lecture hall, bright sparks and violet brush discharges darting off every part of its outer surface.
visualRecipe.focus: the outside of the cube is so strongly charged that sparks fly off it.

scenes.voiceText: Funken und Lichtbüschel sprühen von der ganzen Oberfläche. Es knistert und blitzt.
scenes.factClaim: the outside of the cube is so strongly charged that sparks fly off it.

scenes.title: Faraday steigt hinein

visualRecipe.subject: Michael Faraday with a natural, calm face steps through a small door into the foil-covered cube, faint sparks flickering on the outside wall.
visualRecipe.focus: Faraday walks into the charged cube.

scenes.voiceText: Und dann tut Faraday etwas, das keiner erwartet. Er steigt hinein.
scenes.factClaim: Faraday walks into the charged cube.

scenes.title: Messgeräte im Würfel

visualRecipe.subject: Close view of a glass gold-leaf electrometer on a small wooden table inside the dark cube, a lit candle beside it, the two thin gold leaves hanging straight down.
visualRecipe.focus: inside the cube Faraday tests for electricity with a gold-leaf electrometer.

scenes.voiceText: Drinnen prüft er alles mit einem Goldblatt-Elektrometer und brennenden Kerzen.
scenes.factClaim: inside the cube Faraday tests for electricity with a gold-leaf electrometer.

scenes.title: Die Goldblättchen bleiben schlaff

visualRecipe.subject: Two gold-leaf electrometers side by side: on the left the leaves spread apart in a V shape, on the right the leaves hang straight down.
visualRecipe.focus: the gold leaves would spread when charged, but stay flat inside the cube.

scenes.voiceText: Bei Ladung würden sich die dünnen Goldblättchen spreizen. Sie bleiben schlaff.
scenes.factClaim: the gold leaves would spread when charged, but stay flat inside the cube.

scenes.title: Außen Funken, innen Ruhe

visualRecipe.subject: Cross-section through the cube: sparks crackling along the outer wall, inside Faraday with a natural face sits calmly reading his instruments by candlelight.
visualRecipe.focus: outside violent sparks, inside complete calm.

scenes.voiceText: Draußen kracht es. Drinnen passiert nichts. Kein Funke, kein Zucken.
scenes.factClaim: outside violent sparks, inside complete calm.

scenes.title: Faradays Notizen

visualRecipe.subject: An old leather-bound laboratory journal open on a wooden desk with a quill pen, the page showing only a small hand-drawn sketch of a cube, no readable writing.
visualRecipe.focus: Faraday documented that he lived inside the cube without any effect.

scenes.voiceText: Faraday notiert später, er habe in dem Würfel regelrecht gewohnt.
scenes.factClaim: Faraday documented that he lived inside the cube without any effect.

scenes.title: Der Faradaysche Käfig

visualRecipe.subject: Clean schematic of a wire-mesh cage drawn in perspective on a physics lab board, small charge symbols only on the outside of the mesh.
visualRecipe.focus: a closed conductive shell is called a Faraday cage.

scenes.voiceText: So eine leitende Hülle trägt seitdem seinen Namen: Faradayscher Käfig.
scenes.factClaim: a closed conductive shell is called a Faraday cage.

scenes.title: Auto als Käfig

visualRecipe.stage: split view of a lecture hall and a modern street
visualRecipe.subject: Side-by-side comparison: Faraday's foil cube on the left and a modern hatchback on the right, both with their conductive outer shell highlighted in the same muted blue.
visualRecipe.focus: a modern car body works like Faraday's cube.

scenes.voiceText: Und dein Auto ist genau so ein Käfig. Doch warum bleibt es innen still?
scenes.factClaim: a modern car body works like Faraday's cube.

scenes.title: Gleiche Ladungen stoßen sich ab

visualRecipe.subject: Simple diagram on a lab board: two negative charge spheres with arrows pointing away from each other.
visualRecipe.focus: like charges push each other apart.

scenes.voiceText: Der Trick steckt in einer einfachen Regel. Gleiche Ladungen stoßen sich ab.
scenes.factClaim: like charges push each other apart.
scenes.chapterTitle: Was der Strom um dich herum macht

scenes.title: Ladung verteilt sich

visualRecipe.stage: metal sheet on a lab bench
visualRecipe.subject: A flat metal plate on a lab bench with small charge symbols spreading from the centre towards the edges, short arrows showing the outward movement.
visualRecipe.focus: charge on metal spreads out as far as it can.

scenes.voiceText: Landet Ladung auf Metall, rückt sie so weit auseinander wie möglich. Jedes Teilchen will Abstand.
scenes.factClaim: charge on metal spreads out as far as it can.

scenes.title: Ladung sitzt außen

visualRecipe.subject: Cutaway of a hollow metal sphere on a demonstration stand: charge symbols sit only on the outer surface, the inside is empty.
visualRecipe.focus: charge collects only on the outer surface of a metal body.

scenes.voiceText: Weiter als bis zur Oberfläche kommt sie nicht. Also sammelt sie sich außen.
scenes.factClaim: charge collects only on the outer surface of a metal body.

scenes.title: Kräfte heben sich auf

visualRecipe.subject: Diagram of the hollow sphere interior: a small test charge in the centre with equal arrows from opposite sides pointing at it, cancelling out.
visualRecipe.focus: inside the shell the pushes from all sides cancel each other.

scenes.voiceText: Im Inneren schieben die Ladungen von allen Seiten gleich stark. Ihre Kräfte heben sich genau auf.
scenes.factClaim: inside the shell the pushes from all sides cancel each other.

scenes.title: Kein Feld im Inneren

visualRecipe.subject: Schematic of a closed metal shell with curved electric field lines all around the outside and a clean empty interior without any lines.
visualRecipe.focus: the electric field exists outside the shell but is zero inside.

scenes.voiceText: Das elektrische Feld, also das, was Ladungen anschiebt, ist im Inneren null.
scenes.factClaim: the electric field exists outside the shell but is zero inside.

scenes.title: Die Karosserie als Hülle

visualRecipe.subject: In a car factory body shop, two workers with natural faces inspect a bare unpainted steel car body shell on an assembly line.
visualRecipe.focus: the car's sheet-metal body is the conductive shell.

scenes.voiceText: Bei deinem Auto übernimmt die Karosserie aus Stahlblech genau diese Rolle.
scenes.factClaim: the car's sheet-metal body is the conductive shell.

scenes.title: Entscheidung kurz vor dem Boden

visualRecipe.subject: Side-view diagram of an open landscape with a motorway: a lightning leader descending from the sky, and a highlighted zone just above the ground where it chooses its target.
visualRecipe.focus: where lightning strikes is decided only in the last stretch above the ground.

scenes.voiceText: Wohin genau ein Blitz fällt, entscheidet sich erst auf den letzten 10 bis 100 Metern.
scenes.factClaim: where lightning strikes is decided only in the last stretch above the ground.

scenes.title: Treffer aufs Dach

visualRecipe.stage: motorway rest area in a storm
visualRecipe.subject: A lightning bolt hits the roof of a parked car at a motorway rest area in heavy rain, bright point of impact on the roof.
visualRecipe.focus: the lightning hits the roof of a parked car.

scenes.voiceText: Nehmen wir an, er trifft dein Dach. Ein greller Schlag, direkt über deinem Kopf.
scenes.factClaim: the lightning hits the roof of a parked car.

scenes.title: Der Weg über das Blech

visualRecipe.stage: car side view on a road
visualRecipe.subject: Side-view technical drawing of a car with semi-transparent body: bold arrows run from the roof along the pillars and door sills down towards the wheels.
visualRecipe.focus: the current runs over the roof, pillars and sides down to the ground.

scenes.voiceText: Der Strom verteilt sich und fließt über Dach, Säulen und Seitenwände nach unten.
scenes.factClaim: the current runs over the roof, pillars and sides down to the ground.

scenes.title: Blech gegen Körper

visualRecipe.subject: Comparison of two conductors: a thick steel strip with a wide bright current arrow and a human forearm silhouette with only a thin faint arrow.
visualRecipe.focus: metal conducts far better than the human body.

scenes.voiceText: Blech leitet den Strom viel besser als dein Körper. Fast alles fließt deshalb durchs Metall.
scenes.factClaim: metal conducts far better than the human body.

scenes.title: Außen herum

visualRecipe.stage: car seen from above on a road
visualRecipe.subject: Top-down view of a car on a wet road: bright current arrows run around the outer edge of the roof and body, the seats in the middle stay dark and calm.
visualRecipe.focus: the current flows around the cabin, not through it.

scenes.voiceText: Also nimmt der Strom den bequemsten Weg. Außen herum, an dir vorbei.
scenes.factClaim: the current flows around the cabin, not through it.

scenes.title: Sprung in den Boden

visualRecipe.stage: wheel at road level in rain
visualRecipe.subject: Cross-section through a wheel on wet asphalt: steel rim, tire and road, with a bright arc running along the outside of the tire from the wheel arch into the asphalt.
visualRecipe.focus: at the bottom the current jumps past the tire into the ground.

scenes.voiceText: Ganz unten springt er als Lichtbogen über den Reifen in den Boden. Daher die Brandspuren.
scenes.factClaim: at the bottom the current jumps past the tire into the ground.

scenes.title: Strom fließt um dich herum

visualRecipe.stage: inside a car cabin during a thunderstorm
visualRecipe.subject: Inside view of a car during a strike: a driver with a natural, calm face sits upright, thin bright current lines visible only along the roof frame and pillars outside the cabin.
visualRecipe.focus: the occupant sits safely while the current flows around.

scenes.voiceText: Du sitzt mittendrin. Der Strom fließt um dich herum und ist nach einem Wimpernschlag vorbei.
scenes.factClaim: the occupant sits safely while the current flows around.

scenes.title: Kein dichter Käfig nötig

visualRecipe.subject: Close detail of a car side window with its metal door frame surrounding the glass, raindrops on the glass.
visualRecipe.focus: the cage does not need to be completely closed.

scenes.voiceText: Wichtig: Der Käfig muss gar nicht völlig dicht sein.
scenes.factClaim: the cage does not need to be completely closed.

scenes.title: Fenster als Lücken

visualRecipe.stage: technical drawing of a car body
visualRecipe.subject: Schematic wireframe of a car body drawn as a metal cage, the window openings left open, all frame members joined in one continuous conductive loop.
visualRecipe.focus: window openings are fine as long as the shell is connected all round.

scenes.voiceText: Fenster sind kein Problem, solange die Hülle rundum leitend verbunden ist. Ein grobes Metallgitter reicht schon.
scenes.factClaim: window openings are fine as long as the shell is connected all round.

scenes.title: Wie oft schlägt es ein?

visualRecipe.stage: hilly countryside at night in a storm
visualRecipe.subject: Night view over hilly countryside with several lightning bolts hitting the ground at once in the distance, a lit village below.
visualRecipe.focus: lightning strikes the ground very often.

scenes.voiceText: Und wie oft schlägt so ein Blitz überhaupt ein? Eine einzige Gewitterzelle erzeugt zwei bis vier Blitze pro Minute.
scenes.factClaim: lightning strikes the ground very often.
scenes.chapterTitle: Cabrio, E-Auto, Motorrad: Wer ist sicher?

scenes.title: Blitze in Deutschland

visualRecipe.stage: lightning detection station in a meadow
visualRecipe.subject: A lightning detection antenna on a mast in a meadow, next to it a small shelter with an open door showing a monitor full of tiny strike dots.
visualRecipe.focus: hundreds of thousands of strikes are measured every year.

scenes.voiceText: 2023 zählte der Blitzdienst BLIDS in Deutschland rund 316.000 Einschläge.
scenes.factClaim: hundreds of thousands of strikes are measured every year.

scenes.title: Spitzenreiter Memmingen

visualRecipe.stage: small Allgäu town under a storm
visualRecipe.subject: A small Bavarian town with a church tower and gabled roofs under a heavy thunderstorm, one lightning bolt hitting the hills behind it.
visualRecipe.focus: the highest lightning density was measured in Memmingen in the Allgäu.

scenes.voiceText: Am dichtesten traf es Memmingen im Allgäu. Nirgends schlug es auf gleicher Fläche öfter ein.
scenes.factClaim: the highest lightning density was measured in Memmingen in the Allgäu.

scenes.title: Treffer ins Auto sind selten

visualRecipe.subject: Top-down view of a busy motorway in light rain with many cars, a single distant lightning bolt hitting an empty field beside the road.
visualRecipe.focus: a direct hit on a car is extremely rare.

scenes.voiceText: Ein Treffer ins Auto ist trotzdem äußerst selten. Aber wenn, zählt nur die Hülle.
scenes.factClaim: a direct hit on a car is extremely rare.

scenes.title: Ohne Blech über dem Kopf?

visualRecipe.stage: country road with an approaching storm
visualRecipe.subject: An open convertible driving on a country road, a dark storm front approaching, the driver with a natural face looking up at the sky.
visualRecipe.focus: some vehicles have no metal roof above the occupants.

scenes.voiceText: Doch was passiert, wenn über deinem Kopf gar kein Blech ist?
scenes.factClaim: some vehicles have no metal roof above the occupants.

scenes.title: Metallbügel im Verdeck

visualRecipe.subject: Cutaway of a closed convertible soft top: the fabric partly peeled back to reveal the metal bows and the windscreen frame connected to the body.
visualRecipe.focus: a closed soft top contains metal bows that conduct the lightning.

scenes.voiceText: Beim Cabrio kommt es auf das Verdeck an. Geschlossen leiten Metallbügel darin den Blitz ab.
scenes.factClaim: a closed soft top contains metal bows that conduct the lightning.

scenes.title: Brandfleck im Stoff

visualRecipe.subject: Close-up of convertible roof fabric with a small dark scorch mark next to a seam, the metal bow faintly visible beneath.
visualRecipe.focus: in tests only the fabric got scorched.

scenes.voiceText: In Laborversuchen blieb das Innere geschützt. Nur der Stoff bekam Brandflecken.
scenes.factClaim: in tests only the fabric got scorched.

scenes.title: Keine bekannten Verletzten

visualRecipe.stage: parking bay with a closed convertible in the rain
visualRecipe.subject: Two relaxed people with natural faces sit inside a convertible with the soft top fully closed, rain running down the windows, a distant lightning flash outside.
visualRecipe.focus: occupants of a closed convertible are protected.

scenes.voiceText: Verletzte Cabrio-Insassen durch Blitze sind dem ADAC nicht bekannt.
scenes.factClaim: occupants of a closed convertible are protected.

scenes.title: Dach ohne Metall

visualRecipe.stage: two convertibles side by side in a garage
visualRecipe.subject: Two convertibles side by side in cutaway: the left roof with metal bows forming a closed frame, the right roof with fabric only and no metal inside.
visualRecipe.focus: without metal in the roof there is no cage.

scenes.voiceText: Manche Cabriodächer kommen aber ganz ohne Metall aus. Dann fehlt der Käfig.
scenes.factClaim: without metal in the roof there is no cage.

scenes.title: Kunststoff schützt nicht

visualRecipe.subject: A white caravan made of glass-fibre plastic on a campsite under a dark thunderstorm sky, no metal frame visible.
visualRecipe.focus: caravans made of glass-fibre plastic offer no lightning protection.

scenes.voiceText: Wohnwagen aus glasfaserverstärktem Kunststoff schützen gar nicht. Im Wohnmobil ist die Fahrerkabine der sicherste Platz.
scenes.factClaim: caravans made of glass-fibre plastic offer no lightning protection.

scenes.title: Was ist mit dem E-Auto?

visualRecipe.stage: electric car at a charging bay
visualRecipe.subject: Cutaway of an electric car parked at a charging bay, showing the flat high-voltage battery pack in the floor beneath the cabin.
visualRecipe.focus: an electric car carries a large high-voltage battery in its floor.

scenes.voiceText: Und das Elektroauto mit seiner großen Batterie?
scenes.factClaim: an electric car carries a large high-voltage battery in its floor.

scenes.title: Gleicher Schutz

visualRecipe.subject: An electric car and a petrol car parked side by side in the rain, both with their metal body shell highlighted in the same muted blue.
visualRecipe.focus: electric and combustion cars are protected the same way by their metal body.

scenes.voiceText: Laut ADAC bietet es den gleichen Schutz wie ein Verbrenner. Entscheidend ist die Metallhülle, nicht der Motor.
scenes.factClaim: electric and combustion cars are protected the same way by their metal body.

scenes.title: Kein Käfig auf dem Motorrad

visualRecipe.stage: country road shoulder in a storm
visualRecipe.subject: A motorcyclist with open visor and a natural, alert face pulls over onto the shoulder of a country road as lightning flashes in the distance.
visualRecipe.focus: riders of motorcycles and bicycles have no protective cage.

scenes.voiceText: Auf dem Motorrad oder Fahrrad hast du keinen Käfig um dich. Hier wird es wirklich gefährlich.
scenes.factClaim: riders of motorcycles and bicycles have no protective cage.

scenes.title: Schutz im Gebäude

visualRecipe.subject: A bicycle and a motorcycle parked in front of a village house, the open doorway of the building offering shelter from heavy rain.
visualRecipe.focus: riders should get off and seek shelter in a building.

scenes.voiceText: Dann gilt: absteigen und ein Gebäude suchen.
scenes.factClaim: riders should get off and seek shelter in a building.

scenes.title: Abstand halten und hocken

visualRecipe.subject: Side-view diagram on a roadside: a person with a natural face crouching low on the asphalt, a parked motorcycle at a distance, a dimension line between them.
visualRecipe.focus: keep at least three metres from the vehicle and crouch down.

scenes.voiceText: Geht das nicht, mindestens drei Meter Abstand zum Fahrzeug halten und auf dem Asphalt hinhocken.
scenes.factClaim: keep at least three metres from the vehicle and crouch down.

scenes.title: Folgen für das Auto

visualRecipe.stage: motorway hard shoulder after the rain
visualRecipe.subject: A car stopped on a motorway hard shoulder after a strike, a thin wisp of smoke from a front tire, wet road reflecting the grey sky.
visualRecipe.focus: a lightning strike can still damage the car.

scenes.voiceText: Und auch im Auto bleibt ein Einschlag nicht ohne Folgen.
scenes.factClaim: a lightning strike can still damage the car.

scenes.title: Schäden an der Elektronik

visualRecipe.subject: Cutaway behind a car dashboard showing control units and wiring, one control unit glowing warning red, the infotainment display dark.
visualRecipe.focus: paint, tires and electronics can be damaged.

scenes.voiceText: Lack und Reifen können Schäden abbekommen, die Elektronik kann ausfallen. Lass das Auto danach prüfen.
scenes.factClaim: paint, tires and electronics can be damaged.

scenes.title: Gefahr Schreck

visualRecipe.stage: inside a car cabin on a highway
visualRecipe.subject: A startled driver with a natural face squints at a blinding flash ahead on a highway, both hands jerking the steering wheel.
visualRecipe.focus: the real danger is a startled driver making a mistake.

scenes.voiceText: Die größte Gefahr ist aber der Schreck. Ein greller Blitz, ein Knall, und du verreißt das Lenkrad.
scenes.factClaim: the real danger is a startled driver making a mistake.

scenes.title: Regen und dunkle Ampeln

visualRecipe.subject: A city intersection in heavy rain with switched-off dark traffic lights, cars waiting with headlights on.
visualRecipe.focus: heavy rain and failed traffic lights add to the danger.

scenes.voiceText: Dazu kommen Starkregen und Ampeln, die im Gewitter ausfallen können.
scenes.factClaim: heavy rain and failed traffic lights add to the danger.

scenes.title: Anhalten und sitzen bleiben

visualRecipe.stage: motorway rest area seen from above
visualRecipe.subject: Top-down view of a car parked alone on an open rest area in heavy rain, away from trees and light poles.
visualRecipe.focus: stop during a heavy thunderstorm and stay inside.

scenes.voiceText: Darum bei heftigem Gewitter anhalten. Und sitzen bleiben.
scenes.factClaim: stop during a heavy thunderstorm and stay inside.

scenes.title: Metall nicht anfassen

visualRecipe.subject: Close view inside a car: a hand pulled back and resting on the lap, clearly away from the metal door frame and handle.
visualRecipe.focus: after a strike, do not touch metal parts connected to the body.

scenes.voiceText: Nach einem Einschlag keine Metallteile anfassen, die mit der Karosserie verbunden sind.
scenes.factClaim: after a strike, do not touch metal parts connected to the body.

scenes.title: Zurück zum Anfang

visualRecipe.subject: Cutaway of a car being struck on a rainy night road: the lightning current running along the outside of the body, the cabin inside shown calm and dark.
visualRecipe.focus: the extreme heat and current flow over the outside of the car.

scenes.voiceText: Zurück zu den 30.000 Grad und den 20.000 Ampere vom Anfang.
scenes.factClaim: the extreme heat and current flow over the outside of the car.

scenes.title: Sie erreichen dich nicht

visualRecipe.stage: inside a car cabin during a thunderstorm
visualRecipe.subject: A relaxed driver with a natural face sits with hands in the lap, watching a lightning flash through the rain-covered windshield.
visualRecipe.focus: the lightning reaches the car but not the person inside.

scenes.voiceText: Sie treffen dein Auto. Aber sie erreichen dich nicht.
scenes.factClaim: the lightning reaches the car but not the person inside.

scenes.title: Blech statt Gummi

visualRecipe.subject: Side view of a car: the tires shown greyed out, the metal body shell highlighted in muted blue with a check mark shape beside it.
visualRecipe.focus: the metal body protects you, not the rubber tires.

scenes.voiceText: Nicht der Gummi schützt dich, sondern das Blech um dich herum.
scenes.factClaim: the metal body protects you, not the rubber tires.

scenes.title: Drinnen bleiben

visualRecipe.subject: Two side-by-side panels on a stormy roadside: on the left a person with a natural face sits inside the car with the metal shell highlighted, on the right the same person stands outside in the rain without any shell around them.
visualRecipe.focus: inside the car you are protected, outside you are not.

scenes.voiceText: Steig also nicht aus, um nachzusehen. Draußen hast du keinen Käfig mehr.
scenes.factClaim: inside the car you are protected, outside you are not.

scenes.title: Faradays Beweis

visualRecipe.subject: Michael Faraday with a natural face sits at a small table inside the foil cube writing notes by candlelight, faint sparks visible through a gap in the wall.
visualRecipe.focus: Faraday proved the principle in 1836.

scenes.voiceText: Faraday hat das 1836 in seinem Würfel bewiesen, mit Kerzen und Goldblättchen.
scenes.factClaim: Faraday proved the principle in 1836.

scenes.title: Um dich herum, nicht durch dich

visualRecipe.stage: motorway rest area after the storm
visualRecipe.subject: A car parked on a rest area at dusk after a storm, the clouds breaking up, a last distant lightning flash on the horizon, the driver inside calm.
visualRecipe.focus: the car is your own Faraday cage in every thunderstorm.

scenes.voiceText: Darum gilt: Der Blitz fließt um dich herum, nicht durch dich. Bei jedem Gewitter sitzt du in Faradays Würfel.
scenes.factClaim: the car is your own Faraday cage in every thunderstorm.
